spice_disable_ticketing.description: Do not require a client password.

spice_password.description: Set the password required to connect to the Spice server.

spice_sasl.description: Enable usage of SASL supported by the spice-gtk client.

spice_port.description: Use Spice's regular unencrypted port. Specify 0 to disable.

spice_x509_dir.description: Set the directory where the CA certificate, server key and server certificate are searched for TLS.

spice_cacert_file.description: Set the CA certificate file location for TLS.

spice_x509_key_file.description: Set the server key file location for TLS.

spice_x509_key_password.description: Set the server key's password for TLS.

spice_x509_cert_file.description: Set the server certificate file location for TLS.

spice_dh_file.description: Set the server DH file location for TLS.

spice_tls_ciphers.description: Set the TLS ciphers preference order.

spice_addr.description: Listen to a specific interface. Empty means all (0.0.0.0).

spice_ipv4_only.description: Set to True to only listen on IPv4 interfaces.

spice_ipv6_only.description: Set to True to only listen on IPv6 interfaces.

spice_exit_on_disconnect.description: If set, the Spice server will exit when the first client disconnects.

num_heads.description: The number of heads to allocate by default.

spice_zlib_glz_wan_compression.description: Set zlib glz wan compression. Options are auto, never, always.

spice_jpeg_wan_compression.description: Set jpeg wan compression. Options are auto, never, always.

spice_image_compression.description: Set image compression. Options are off, auto_glz, auto_lz, quic, glz, lz.

spice_deferred_fps.description: If non zero, render operations to frame buffer and transmit changed rectangles at this rate.

spice_streaming_video.description: Set the streaming video method. Options are filter, off, all.

spice_video_codecs.description: Sets a semicolon-separated list of preferred video codecs.

enable_image_cache.description: Enable caching of images directly written with uxa->put_image.

enable_fallback_cache.description: Enable caching of images created by uxa->prepare_access.

enable_surfaces.description: Enable the use of off-screen surfaces.

surface_buffer_size.description: The amount of surface buffer ram, in megabytes, to allocate.

command_buffer_size.description: The amount of command buffer ram, in megabytes, to allocate.

frame_buffer_size.description: The amount of frame buffer ram, in megabytes, to reserve.

spice_vdagent_enabled.description: Whether or not to accept Vdagent connections.

spice_vdagent_virtio_path.description: Default path to listen for agent virtual io connections.

spice_vdagent_uinput_path.description: Default path to listen for agent uinput connections.

spice_vdagent_uid.description: Default user id to set for the Virtio and Uinput sockets.

spice_vdagent_gid.description: Default group id to set for the Virtio and Uinput sockets.

spice_agent_mouse.description: Set Spice Agent Mouse - Use Agent mouse if an agent connects.

spice_playback_fifo_dir.description: If a directory is given, any file in that directory will be read for audio data to be sent to the client.

spice_smartcard_file.description: A unix domain name for a unix domain socket to communicate with a spiceccid smartcard driver.
